## Optional evidence / 可选证据

A short error excerpt or cropped screenshot is enough. Remove keys, session IDs, private messages, paths containing personal information, and memory contents before posting. Do not attach full profiles, logs or state files.
简短报错或裁剪截图即可。发布前去掉密钥、会话 ID、私人聊天、包含个人信息的路径和记忆内容；不要上传完整 profile、日志或状态文件。

The one-minute trial is documented in docs/IDLE.md. Enable only the chat you want to test; model calls consume normal usage. This public issue does not start a chat or authorize access to your machine.
一分钟试用见 docs/IDLE.md。只开启你希望测试的会话，模型调用消耗正常用量；提交这个公开反馈不会启动聊天或授权他人访问你的电脑。
